description: This PHP file defines a Smarty plugin function 'sugar_button' that generates HTML buttons for various actions in the SugarCRM application, including save, cancel, delete, duplicate, and custom buttons, with support for custom code and HTML parsing.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_button
methods.description: Main function that generates HTML buttons based on parameters, supporting various button types and custom code, with support for appending output.

methods.name: replaceFormClick
methods.description: Replaces JavaScript onclick handlers in HTML DOM array to support form submission via JavaScript, handling hidden fields and event rewriting.

methods.name: extractHiddenInputs
methods.description: Extracts hidden input fields from a DOM array, removing non-hidden inputs and form tags.
